title: Africa + Mauritius Grand Tour
subtitle: ~4 weeks · August 2027 · a couple · upper-mid comfort

stops.name: Brisbane
stops.highlights: Your starting point. Qantas flies Brisbane–Johannesburg with one connection in Sydney (the Sydney–Joburg leg is the ~14h nonstop).

stops.name: Johannesburg
stops.highlights: African gateway. Overnight if needed, then a short light-aircraft hop up to the Greater Kruger for your first safari.

stops.name: Sabi Sands · Greater Kruger
stops.highlights: The full Big 5 — arguably the best leopard and rhino viewing on the continent, with superb guiding at great upper-mid value.

stops.name: Victoria Falls (Zimbabwe)
stops.highlights: The Falls at their best-viewed low-water season, Devil's Pool open, helicopter flights, and an optional Chobe elephant day-trip.

stops.name: Masai Mara (via Nairobi)
stops.highlights: The grand finale on land: the Great Migration and its dramatic Mara River crossings, at their August peak.

stops.name: Mauritius
stops.highlights: Wind down on the sheltered north/west coast — sunny winter days, calm warm sea, and peak humpback whale season.

stops.name: Home to Brisbane
stops.highlights: Fly Mauritius → Johannesburg, then Qantas back to Brisbane via Sydney — closing the loop through your African gateway.

legs.label: Fly to JNB, then Qantas home via SYD
